lyrics:
[Intro: gritty guitar riff, kick drum and tambourine]

[Verse 1: gravel male baritone]
I ran a tab in every town I ever blew through
Hearts and promises and money, coming due
Had a ledger on me longer than the Mississippi
Collectors at the door and not a dime to give 'em

[Pre-Chorus: band tightening]
Then the notice came. I opened it slow.
Thought it was the end. It said, "You don't owe."

[Chorus: big, choir behind, shout-along]
Paid in full, signed in red
Every line, every cent, every word I said
Somebody took my debt and wrote his name instead
I walked out of that courtroom with a lifted head
Paid in full, and signed in red

[Verse 2: voice lower, organ under]
I asked the judge, "Who covers a bill like mine?"
He said, "My own son. Stepped up. Got in line.
Took your sentence, took it up a hill.
Last thing he said was 'finished.' It was. It is. Still."

[Chorus: big, choir behind, shout-along]
Paid in full, signed in red
Every line, every cent, every word I said
Somebody took my debt and wrote his name instead
I walked out of that courtroom with a lifted head
Paid in full, and signed in red

[Guitar Solo: slide guitar, bluesy, choir humming]

[Bridge: organ and choir, testifying]
If you owe more than you can ever pay
There's a man with scars who'll take it away
Jesus paid it! All of it! Mine!
Jesus paid it! All of it! Yours!

[Final Chorus: loudest, choir and handclaps]
Paid in full, signed in red
Every line, every cent, every word I said
Jesus took my debt and wrote his name instead
I walked out of that courtroom with a lifted head
Paid in full, and signed in red

[Outro: guitar riff, a gavel, a heavy door swinging open]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 84 BPM, 4/4, G major. A mid-tempo Southern rock shuffle with a heavy backbeat.

VOICE: Male baritone, deep and gravelly, half-growled in the verses and opened to a roar in the choruses. A gospel choir sings behind every chorus and takes over the bridge with him shouting on top.

INSTRUMENTS: A gritty, overdriven guitar riff, slide guitar, a loud kick and snare with tambourine, bass, Hammond organ, barroom piano, a gospel choir, handclaps in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro riff. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:40 Pre-chorus. 0:50 Chorus 1. 1:16 Verse 2, the judge's answer. 1:44 Chorus 2. 2:10 Guitar solo. 2:26 Bridge, choir. 2:48 Final chorus. 3:14 Outro, riff, a gavel and a door at 3:26.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Southern rock with a church choir: warm, heavy, guitars dirty, choir wide, voice out front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Last thing he said was "finished." It was. It is. Still.' at 1:36.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are a debtor's lucky day. Verse 2 at 1:16 has the judge say who paid: his own son, on a hill, with one last word. The bridge shouts the name over a line borrowed from an old hymn title.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Cornered, stunned, grateful, testifying.
